hook.en: Silver chloride precipitates the instant you mix the solutions; an iron gate takes months to rust. Chemical kinetics measures how fast reactions go and why.
hook.kn: ದ್ರಾವಣಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆರೆಸಿದ ಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಸಿಲ್ವರ್ ಕ್ಲೋರೈಡ್ ಅವಕ್ಷೇಪಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ; ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ಗೇಟ್ ತುಕ್ಕು ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ತಿಂಗಳುಗಳು ಬೇಕು. ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಚಲನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳ ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The rate of a reaction is the change in concentration of a reactant or product per unit time. For R → P, the average rate is −Δ[R]/Δt = Δ[P]/Δt. Because the rate keeps changing, we also use the instantaneous rate, −d[R]/dt, which is the slope of the tangent to the concentration–time curve at that moment. Units: mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹; for gases, atm s⁻¹.
body.kn: ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ದರ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಕಾರಿ ಅಥವಾ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನದ ಸಾರತೆಯ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ. ತಾತ್ಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ದರ ಸಾರತೆ–ಕಾಲ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕದ ಇಳಿಜಾರು.

title.en: On the board: rate of a reaction

say.en: As a reaction runs, reactant concentration falls and product concentration rises, fast at first and then more slowly.
The slope of the tangent at any moment is the instantaneous rate. Average rate uses two points far apart.
Rate is the fall in reactant concentration, or rise in product concentration, per unit time. Divide by the coefficients so every species gives the same rate.
Example: nitrogen pentoxide is used up at 0.02 mol per litre per second. Nitrogen dioxide forms twice as fast; oxygen half as fast.

text.en: N₂O₅ used at 0.02 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹

title.en: Rate in terms of each species

body.en: For aA + bB → cC + dD, dividing each rate by its coefficient gives one rate of reaction for the whole equation. For example, in 2HI → H₂ + I₂, rate = −½ d[HI]/dt = d[H₂]/dt = d[I₂]/dt.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ದರವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಗುಣಾಂಕದಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ ಇಡೀ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ದರ ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: Concentration of a reactant against time, with the tangent at the chosen moment. The tangent slope is the instantaneous rate.

tryThis.en: Move t later: the tangent gets flatter, so the reaction slows down.
Compare the average rate (0 to t) with the instantaneous rate at t: the average is larger here because the reaction was faster early on.

problem.en: For 2N₂O₅ → 4NO₂ + O₂, N₂O₅ disappears at 0.02 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹. Find the rate of reaction and the rates of formation of NO₂ and O₂.

steps.en: Rate = −½ d[N₂O₅]/dt = ½ × 0.02 = 0.01 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹.

answer.en: Rate = 0.01; NO₂: 0.04; O₂: 0.01 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹

narration.en: Let us solve this together. For 2N₂O₅ → 4NO₂ + O₂, N₂O₅ disappears at 0.02 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹. Find the rate of reaction and the rates of formation of NO₂ and O₂.

problem.en: The concentration of a reactant R falls from 0.5 mol L⁻¹ to 0.3 mol L⁻¹ in 20 minutes. Find the average rate in mol L⁻¹ min⁻¹ and in mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹.

answer.en: 0.01 mol L⁻¹ min⁻¹ = 1.67 × 10⁻⁴ mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹
